description: Check whether an offer fits a buyer's situation: {customer: new|existing, plan, billing: monthly|annual|biennial}. Returns matches, does_not_match (with reasons) or needs_confirmation (missing information, an unconfirmed offer, or a pilot granted case by case), plus what the vendor did not state. A match is not a checkout guarantee.

offer_id.description: The offer's id, from the id field of a search_offers result.
offer_id.title: Offer Id

situation.description: The buyer's situation as {customer: 'new' or 'existing', plan: plan name, billing: 'monthly', 'annual' or 'biennial'}; missing fields are reported as needing confirmation.
situation.title: Situation

name: check_offer_eligibility
